newPath.description: New mailbox path as an array or a string. If account is namespaced then namespace prefix is added by default. Optional.
newPath.title: TargetMailboxPath

x-meta.usage: Only IMAP accounts have a subscription list, so this is ignored for Gmail API and MS Graph accounts. It controls whether a folder shows up in clients that list subscribed folders only; it does not affect whether EmailEngine syncs it, which `path` on the account decides.
